title: Two Calls
reference: F1(3) def F1 { forward F1 F1 turn_left }
hints: F1 can call itself twice. Each call is a smaller copy of the whole pattern.
F1: forward, F1, F1, turn left.
F1(3) def F1 { forward F1 F1 turn_left }

story.intro: PATCH: "Fern Hall. When a function calls itself twice, the pattern splits in two, then in two again."
